messages.subject: Problems with excursions.inla
parts:
Hi, so I am having this issue. 
I have fitted an INLA model and have the results. 
I then run the excursions.inla function: 
system.time(left_exc1 <- excursions.inla(my_result$INLA_result$left, name='zerobk', u=0, type='>', method=method, verbose = TRUE))
 When I use the EB or QC methods it works.
 When I use the NI and NIQC I get this error: 
Calculating marginal probabilities
 Calculating excursion function using the NI method Configuration
 1 of 1 Error in res[[i]] : subscript out of bounds

I have also put the my_result$INLA_result$left object struct in the email. 
Would you know what could be causing these issues? 

Thank you very much.
